summary: Token Cat Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing that effective August 28, 2026, Guangsheng Liu resigned as director, Chairman, CEO, and CFO, with no disagreement related to operations, policies, or practices. The remaining board elected Zhanli Wang as his successor across all four positions. Wang previously served as Operations Director at Ruitong Technology since February 2021, with prior technical roles at Maijiu and Wuchuang Technology. This is a forced/abrupt leadership transition involving the simultaneous departure of the top executive and board chair, constituting a special situation under Management Changes. What to watch: strategic direction and operational continuity under the new leadership.
